No candidate code is executed by the agent; product acceptance requires the separate trusted verifier.
eve has no public maxRetries setting for this agent configuration. The wrapper limits repeated calls through one model instance, but durable replay after a crash can create another instance.
Provider-side accepted work may continue after a client timeout; dedicated spending restrictions and authoritative cost reconciliation remain necessary.
